intro:
I don't want to give too much away, 
but something rather exciting is coming, 
and you're going to be one of the first to know about it. 🤫
As one of our VIPs, you get early access before anyone else, so keep an eye on your inbox over the next couple of days.
All I'll say for now is, if you've had your eye on any of our wall art sets, this is the moment you've been waiting for. 🖼️
copy.closingText: Exciting things ahead, I promise it'll be worth the wait. Mae x
